fbp:CommercialAndCorporateSegmentMember: The Commercial and Corporate Banking segment consists of the Corporation lending and other services for large customers represented by specialized and middle-market clients and the public sector.
fbp:TreasuryAndInvestmentsSegmentMember: The Treasury and Investments segment is responsible for the Corporation investment portfolio and treasury functions that are executed to manage and enhance liquidity.
fbp:UnitedStatesOperationsSegmentMember: The United States Operations segment consists of all banking activities conducted by FirstBank in the United States mainland, including commercial and retail banking services.
fbp:VirginIslandsOperationsSegmentMember: The Virgin Islands Operations segment consists of all banking activities conducted by the Corporation in the USVI and BVI, including commercial and retail banking services.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Long-term debt (incl. current portion)
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans, current maturities included: financial.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
